sources.title: TNGIS open GeoServer (WFS): district, taluk, block and village panchayat boundaries, TN WRD sub-basins and reservoirs, micro-watershed atlas, all-water-bodies and all-tanks registers, mine leases, industry register matched to land parcels
sources.license: Tamil Nadu government data on an open GeoServer (WFS, no login); published with TNGIS's permission and with attribution.

provenance.note: Namakkal district's rivers, groundwater and industry (scope namakkal-rivers; the district's own scope id is tn-namakkal). The district boundary is the frame and TN WRD's sub-basins, clipped to it, are the catchments (shedId). The industry register holds only units TNGIS matched to a land parcel, so every count is a lower bound; sector comes from the reviewed TNPCB type-code lookup pipeline-inputs/basins/tn-tnpcb-type-sectors.json.

properties.name: near Cauvery Nagar, Kumarapalayam
properties.description: Outfall OF2, 'near Cauvery Nagar, Kumarapalayam': one of 19 outfalls TNPCB's 2019 Cauvery action plan identifies on the Kumarapalayam office's 60.4 km reach (p.84), where it records sewage drains reaching the River Cauvery (pp.74, 103). The plan gives no flow or BOD for it. Position is the plan's own GPS coordinate (p.85).
